# Welcome

Welcome to the Precision Teaching study website. This page includes the required activities for participants assigned to this study condition.

In this condition, you will complete weekly instructional videos with embedded response prompts, use guided notes while watching the videos, and complete weekly quizzes.

## Study Timeline

| Week | Required Activities |
|---|---|
| Pre Study Activities | Complete the pretest,complete onboarding survey, confirm reciept of guided notes package |
| Week 1 | Week 1 video and Week 1 quiz |
| Week 2 | Complete the Week 2 video and Week 2 quiz |
| Week 3 | Complete the Week 3 video and Week 3 quiz |
| Week 4 | Complete the Week 4 video and Week 4 quiz |
| Week 5 | Complete the Week 5 video, posttest, and Week 5 quiz |

## Guided Notes

Please use your guided notes packet while watching each weekly video. The guided notes are designed to help you follow along with the instructional content and complete the embedded response prompts.

If you do not have access to your guided notes packet, contact the research team before beginning the weekly video.

## FAQ

### Do I need to complete the guided notes?

Yes. Participants in this condition should complete the guided notes while watching each weekly video.

### Do I need to answer the questions embedded in the videos?

Yes. The videos include required response prompts. Please complete each prompt before continuing.

### Do I have a coaching session?

No. This condition does not include live coaching sessions.

### What should I do if a link does not work?

Contact the research team at precisionteaching5weeks@gmail.com
